summary_markdown: A user reported an issue with data visualization and retrieval. Specifically, when downloading sensor data for two facilities in the Indian time zone (Asia/Calcutta), the displayed data incorrectly defaults to the local time zone (+03) regardless of the selected setting. The user also requested a specific export format showing date stamps with the correct offset (e.g., 2023-08-22T00:00:00+05:30). Another team member mentioned that two issues were currently being investigated with another colleague.
decisions: The user provided a URL for the affected dashboard view.
action_items: Investigate data discrepancies related to time zone settings and export formatting for sensor data.
